subject: Post-remediation re-verify request & adjusted scope confirmation
messages:
From: Jordan Harris <jordan.harris@blueridgehealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueRidge Health Security Team <security@blueridgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re-verify request after remediation — proposed verification window

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the remediation status update attached to the SIG. We're getting our SOC2 audit kicked off the week of Dec 6 and need to confirm a short vendor re-verify before the auditor's site visit. Can you confirm the following for BlueRidge Health?

- Proposed re-verify window (2–3 day preferred)
- A short delta summary that highlights what changed since the last pen test (bullet form)
- A verification letter or attestation we can provide to our auditor that states the fixes were validated by Redwood's security team and/or an independent vendor

Also please include any evidence bundles you plan to share with our vendor (Ava Consulting) so we can route them to the right reviewers. If there are any scope adjustments you propose for the re-verify (e.g., exclude low-risk staging endpoints that were out of scope), call them out.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — ideally we need confirmation by EOD Monday 11/16 so we can schedule Ava.

Best,
Jordan Harris
Security & Compliance Lead
BlueRidge Health

From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Harris <jordan.harris@blueridgehealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T08:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Re-verify request after remediation — proposed verification window

Jordan — thanks for the note and the timeline. Short answers up front: we can support a 48-hour verification window the week of Nov 30–Dec 4 or Dec 7–11 (your preference), and we'll deliver a delta summary + verification letter in advance of the vendor test.

What we'll provide to Ava Consulting:
- remediation-evidence-20261110.zip (logs, config diffs, remediation tickets)
- redwood_pt_delta_summary_v2.pdf (one-page bullet summary of fixes)
- redwood_remediation_manifest_20261110.csv (asset list + change categories)

Proposed scope adjustment: exclude the ephemeral dev/staging endpoints listed in the manifest under "dev-excluded" — these were explicitly out of scope for your previous test and are not part of the production surface. Monica and Vivek are looped in to confirm the technical details.

Next steps:
1) Monica will attach the evidence bundle and delta PDF in this thread by EOD tomorrow.
2) Once you confirm the preferred week we will coordinate with Ava and post a firm 48-hour window.
3) We'll provide a signed verification letter on Redwood letterhead and a short attestation (PDF) before Ava begins.

If you want us to include a lightweight acceptance test matrix (top 10 checks) for Ava to run, we can — that tends to speed things up.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0192

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Harris <jordan.harris@blueridgehealth.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Re-verify request — remediation evidence & delta summary attached

Hi Jordan / Tessa — attaching the artifacts mentioned below. Quick technical debrief in bullets (delta highlights):

- CVE-2026-3451 (third-party service adapter): patched dependency to 3.4.1; dependency injection boundaries hardened.
- Internal cross-service auth token leakage (low risk): rotated service tokens, added stricter token scoping, and implemented a short-lived token refresh flow.
- Misconfigured CORS on analytics endpoint: corrected allowed-origins, added origin-level denylist and request validation.
- Hardening: disabled unused admin RPC endpoints behind feature flags; updated RBAC rules for ops team.

Evidence attached: remediation-evidence-20261110.zip (contains patch commits, config diff, container image digests, and unit/regression test outputs). Also attaching redwood_pt_delta_summary_v2.pdf (1 page) and the remediation manifest CSV. Please note the following non-production items we propose to exclude from the re-verify scope: dev-worker-*, staging-metrics-prodproxy (listed under dev-excluded in manifest).

Suggested verification window: Dec 7–8 (48 hours) — gives us time to finalize documentation and coordinate with Ava. If you need the earlier window (Nov 30–Dec 1), we can try but will need to accelerate evidence handoff today.

Attachments:
- remediation-evidence-20261110.zip (zip)
- redwood_pt_delta_summary_v2.pdf (pdf)
- redwood_remediation_manifest_20261110.csv (csv)

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Harris <jordan.harris@blueridgehealth.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Re-verify request — scheduling confirmed + verification letter request

Thanks Monica — the delta summary and evidence list look good. Dec 7–8 works for us; I've penciled Ava in for that window and asked their lead to expect the bundle. A couple of asks before we lock: 

1) Formal verification letter: can you provide a short signed letter on Redwood letterhead that states the fixes were validated internally and will be validated by Ava during the re-verify window? The auditor prefers a one-page letter they can keep in their SOC2 evidence packet.
2) DocuSign / delivery preference: we prefer a PDF emailed to security@blueridgehealth.com and also a DocuSign link if you use one for signature.

If you can confirm both items by end of day tomorrow (11/17), we will circulate to our auditor. Thanks for the fast turnaround — appreciate the clarity in the delta bullets.

Jordan Harris
Security & Compliance Lead
BlueRidge Health
